description: Simulates a circuit and returns the voltage across and current through every part once it settles, such as the current through an LED, the output of a voltage divider or whether a bulb lights. Also names faults: a short circuit, nothing flowing, an LED over its current rating, a bulb too dim to light. Runs CircuitJS, a real circuit simulator, on a CircuitJS (falstad) circuit or a breadboardhub.com/sim link. Returns the readings, the faults and a link that opens the circuit running live. Takes 10 to 30 seconds. Daily limit per account; an API token raises it.

circuit.description: The circuit: CircuitJS (falstad.com/circuit) text, a "$" options line then one part per line such as "r 176 112 304 112 0 220" for a 220 ohm resistor (at most 20,000 characters), or a breadboardhub.com/sim link that carries one.

name: simulate_circuit
title: Simulate a circuit
